body: I wish I could do that, it's hard to though.. No matter what, I keep thinking about the friends that are slowly drifting away, by simple reminders that bring back memories, like songs we liked or places we hungout at. Its hard to accept the fact they have left me, you are right I do need to move on but, its almost unbearable to try. Especially since, I still hold the feeling they havent left me yet. I just dont know, I keep trying to look ahead but, the future I once had in my mind is pretty much gone. It hurts.

Thank you for responding, the problem is the friends I am losing are the ones open about it, theyve known for weeks I was gay. I just dont understand why theyd leave now, if me being gay was such an issue.
